recipes.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +0/+3 and gains hexproof until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed temporary ability component through normal casting/response/stack and real combat: declared signed-free stat bonuses, targeting, flying/reach legality, trample allocation, first/double strike, lifelink, deathtouch, indestructibility versus destruction/damage/zero toughness, hexproof/shroud ownership, and freshly cast haste/ability removal where declared. Includes cleanup/expiry, populated owned zones, exact cost, snapshot/AI replay, untapping/draw/life/death-loss components as declared. Additional Oracle clauses (must-block requirements, ferocious trample, alternate costs, overload, flashback, kicker effects, madness, split-second response prohibition) require separate authored cases. Not whole-card certification.
